dedupe_keys.name: bada base of aircraft data eurocontrol aircraft performance model

description: BADA (Base of Aircraft Data) is EUROCONTROL's aircraft performance model: theoretical model specifications and aircraft-specific datasets that reproduce the geometric, kinematic and kinetic behaviour of aircraft over the flight envelope and in all phases of flight, built with aircraft manufacturers and operating airlines for trajectory prediction and simulation in air traffic management research and development. Three families exist: BADA 3, the current standard, covers close to 100 percent of aircraft types in the ECAC area over the nominal flight envelope; BADA 4 covers 80 percent of ECAC types with higher precision over the whole envelope for advanced systems and future concepts; BADA H covers helicopters. EUROCONTROL counts more than 1,000 licensed users and more than 1,000 aircraft types covered. The model is generic and applies worldwide wherever those aircraft fly. Access is by licence under EUROCONTROL's terms and conditions of use, one per family, and tools from other companies that embed BADA need EUROCONTROL's permission and a BADA licence. Caveats: the model specifications and datasets are not open, and BADA 4 does not cover all types. BADA drives air traffic simulators for capacity planning, fuel and emissions estimates and trajectory-based network flow studies; it is related to the open OpenAP performance model and the BlueSky simulator.
